agent.text:
I can’t see an image yet. Please upload the image and I’ll help with: - Describing what’s in the photo (objects, people, colors, scene) - Noting any obvious landmarks, signs, or features that might hint at the location - Checking if there’s metadata (EXIF) like GPS coordinates you can share - If you describe the city or area, I can suggest likely places shown and try to estimate where it was taken
If you want, I can also tell you the current time and weather for a location you specify (or for a location you think the photo was taken in). Just tell me the place.
